name: alfacode-team/hkm-plugin-websocket
description: HKM Kernel plugin providing 'realtime.websocket' — an RFC 6455 WebSocket server with authorised channel subscriptions, fanned out across workers through PubSubPort.

suggest.ext-openswoole: Required to RUN the server. Not required to use the frame codec, the handshake or the registry, which is why the protocol is testable without it.

extra.//: No WebSocket library. RFC 6455 framing is a header, a length in one of three forms, and a four-byte XOR — and the parts that are easy to get wrong are the parts a library's defaults hide: whether an unmasked client frame is refused, whether a non-minimal length is refused, and whether Origin is checked at all. Those are this application's security posture, not a dependency's.
